question_vi: Error handling trong Server Actions như thế nào?
question_en: How do you handle errors in Server Actions?
answer_vi: Server Actions có thể throw errors sẽ được catch bởi nearest error.tsx. Với useFormState/useActionState, return error object thay vì throw: `return { error: 'Invalid input' }`. Dùng try/catch trong action để handle expected errors (validation, not found) và return user-friendly error states.
answer_en: Server Actions can throw errors, which will be caught by the nearest error.tsx boundary. When using useFormState/useActionState, return an error object instead of throwing: `return { error: 'Invalid input' }`. Use try/catch inside the action to handle expected errors (validation failures, not-found cases) and return user-friendly error state objects.
